title: Tennis point-by-point of any match, day, tournament or player

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: matches = every match of the days you pick (any past day; older than 7 days from our tennis database); matchIds = specific matches by id or URL; tournaments = every match of a tournament edition; players = a player's matches, newest first.

dateFrom.title: From day (UTC)
dateFrom.description: Matches mode: the first day, in UTC. today, yesterday, tomorrow, a date like 2026-09-28, or an offset like -3 (three days ago) or +1. Flashscore's daily lists go 7 days back; days ahead list what is already scheduled (usually 1-2 days).

dateTo.title: To day (UTC)
dateTo.description: Matches mode: the last day, inclusive, same formats as From day. Empty = only the From day. Example: From -7 and To today = the last 8 days.

matchIds.title: Match ids or URLs
matchIds.description: matchIds mode: Flashscore match ids (the 8 characters after mid= or /match/, e.g. llKI871b) or full match URLs. Any date, also older than 7 days. Adds the round (e.g. Final) and the match duration.

tournamentUrls.title: Tournament URLs
tournamentUrls.description: tournaments mode: Flashscore tournament URLs, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/tennis/atp-singles/wimbledon/ (or an edition: .../wimbledon-2019/).

years.title: Years
years.description: tournaments mode: the editions to read, e.g. [2019, 2023]; empty = the latest edition.

playerUrls.title: Players (names or URLs)
playerUrls.description: players mode: player names, e.g. "Jannik Sinner" or "Swiatek", or Flashscore player page URLs.

tours.title: Tours
tours.description: Keep only these tours. Empty = all. challenger-women is the WTA 125 level; teams = Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, Laver Cup ties; other = exhibitions, juniors and the rest.

matchType.title: Singles or doubles
matchType.description: singles (default), doubles (includes mixed doubles), or all (also team ties).

status.title: Status
status.description: finished (default: point-by-point of played matches), live (in play: the points so far), or all.

tournaments.title: Tournament name contains
tournaments.description: Keep matches whose tournament name or category contains any of these, case-insensitive, e.g. Beijing, US Open, W100, Challenger.

players.title: Player name contains
players.description: Keep matches with a player whose name contains any of these, case-insensitive (Flashscore writes names as "Sinner J."): Sinner, Swiatek. A player id also works.

includeStatistics.title: Match statistics
includeStatistics.description: Serve and return statistics for matches that started: aces, double faults, 1st serve %, points won on 1st / 2nd serve, break points saved and converted, service and return games won, for the match and each set. Included in the base price.

pointByPointFormat.title: Point-by-point layout
pointByPointFormat.description: games = each match row carries its games (server, winner, breaks, the points in order). sackmann = finished matches only, one row per match in the layout of Jeff Sackmann's tennis_pointbypoint files (pbp_id, server1, server2, the whole match as one S/R string, score, minutes), ready for the tools built on them. Each string is checked point by point against the final score. Charged per match that has point-by-point, with no separate match row.
enumTitles: Sackmann's layout (one row per finished match)

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum matches to return, counted after the filters. A busy day has 100-200 ATP and WTA singles matches.
